description: Consolidate duplicate manufacturer records in the Aerobridge registry. Currently, there are three variations of the same company: 'Yuneec', 'Yuneec Electric', and the correct canonical record 'Yuneec International'. Your task is to: 1) Re-assign all aircraft currently linked to 'Yuneec' and 'Yuneec Electric' so they are linked to 'Yuneec International' instead. 2) Once all aircraft are moved, delete the redundant 'Yuneec' and 'Yuneec Electric' manufacturer records. CRITICAL: You must NOT delete any aircraft records. Ensure the total number of aircraft in the registry remains unchanged.
